### Mask extent is a cost axis in the measured SDP.81 / alma analogue

Historical rule 1: similar masked-pixel extents with different visibility counts had similar per-call costs in these rows; inspect masked pixels alongside visibility count. This is an observation, not a calibrated size predictor.
